[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
select task.id
where task.closed = false
order by task.due asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.closed = false
where task.state = "todo"
select task.id
order by task.due asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.closed = false
select task.id
order by task.due asc, task.due desc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.priority in ["high", "high"]
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.closed = false
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 0
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from nodes as node
scope subtree aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa
where node.depth >= 0
select node.id
order by node.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.title = "unclosed
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.closed = false order by task.due asc
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where (task.closed = false
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from nodes as node
scope workspace
where true
select node.id
order by node.path
limit 10
....
